_comment: Retrieval benchmark: 20 real, confirmed Code4rena/Cantina findings from rag/corpus-dreusd. Each query is phrased as an auditor would describe a suspected bug pattern while reading code (NOT the finding title verbatim), so the eval measures genuine retrieval, not title matching. ground_truth_ids = the finding's full span in the .rag/dreusd-db collection (header chunk + contiguous chunks until the next finding header), resolved from the rebuilt per-finding index.

cases.finding_title: Vault is vulnerable to first depositor inflation attack
cases.query: first depositor mints tiny share supply then donates to inflate share price so later deposits lose value

cases.finding_title: ETHOracle.getLatestPrice needs to convert to 18 decimals
cases.query: vault reads an ETH price feed that returns fewer than 18 decimals and uses the raw value directly as if it were 18-decimal wei, so collateral valuations are off by orders of magnitude

cases.finding_title: Min and maxAnswer never checked for oracle price feed
cases.query: chainlink price is consumed without checking the feed's min and max answer bounds, so an extreme or stale price is accepted as the market price

cases.finding_title: Incorrect calculation of queued withdrawals can deflate TVL and increase ezETH exchange rate
cases.query: withdrawal requests counted as TVL while ezETH not yet burned, inflating the exchange rate for remaining holders

cases.finding_title: Withdrawals can be locked forever if recipient is a contract
cases.query: withdrawal request whose recipient is a smart contract can never be claimed because the contract cannot call the claim function, permanently locking the funds

cases.finding_title: ETH withdrawals from EigenLayer always fail due to OperatorDelegator's nonReentrant receive()
cases.query: native ETH sent back from EigenLayer always reverts because the operator delegator's receive function is protected by nonReentrant, so ETH withdrawals can never complete

cases.finding_title: Withdrawals logic allows MEV exploits of TVL changes and zero-slippage zero-fee withdrawal
cases.query: withdraw executes immediately at current TVL with no slippage check or fee, sandwichable by MEV on price moves

cases.finding_title: DOS of completeQueuedWithdrawal when ERC20 buffer is filled
cases.query: completeQueuedWithdrawal always reverts when the ERC20 buffer for a token is full, permanently blocking settlement

cases.finding_title: Incorrect withdraw queue balance in TVL calculation
cases.query: the withdraw queue's pending token balance is accounted for incorrectly in the TVL calculation, distorting the reported TVL and exchange rate while withdrawals are queued

cases.finding_title: Fixed heartbeat used for price validation is too stale for some tokens
cases.query: one fixed staleness heartbeat is applied to every price feed even though some assets update far more frequently, so stale prices are accepted as fresh

cases.finding_title: Users still forced to follow previously set cooldownDuration even when cooldown is turned off
cases.query: after admin lowers or disables the cooldown duration, already-queued unstake requests still enforce the old longer cooldown

cases.finding_title: FULL_RESTRICTED Stakers can bypass restriction through approvals
cases.query: a staker whose transfers are fully restricted can still move their staked tokens by routing through an existing allowance approval instead of a direct transfer

cases.finding_title: Blacklisted user can burn tokens during WHITELIST_ENABLED state
cases.query: while the contract is in whitelist-enabled mode a blacklisted account can still burn its own tokens and redeem collateral, defeating the transfer restriction

cases.finding_title: Loss of user funds when completing CASH redemptions
cases.query: when completing a redemption the user's cash tokens are moved or burned incorrectly so the redeeming user loses funds

cases.finding_title: KYCRegistry is susceptible to signature replay attack
cases.query: the same KYC approval signature can be replayed to register multiple different addresses because the signed message does not bind to a specific wallet

cases.finding_title: Adversary can steal user's NFT's if they have set Magnetar as isApprovedForAll
cases.query: user grants blanket approval to a batching contract, then any account can use that approval to transfer the user's NFTs

cases.finding_title: twAML weights can be griefed by burning tokens
cases.query: burning a small amount of tokens shifts twAML voting weight and can grief another user's reward eligibility

cases.finding_title: Transfers where dstEid == HUB_EID will fail
cases.query: cross-chain transfer that targets the hub chain itself uses the same endpoint id and always reverts

cases.finding_title: Permanent loss of user funds due to logical error in refunds
cases.query: when a cross-chain transfer fails the refund path sends the tokens to the wrong party or keeps them stuck, permanently losing user funds

cases.finding_title: Funds locked if slippage params cannot be satisfied
cases.query: when a deposit's expected output cannot be satisfied the transaction is marked failed and the funds stay locked with no way to retry the swap
